research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Spero Foods is engaged in developing processes and compositions for plant-based curd products, as described in 'Compositions of and methods for forming plant-based curd products.' The abstract details methods for producing curd by curdling materials containing at least 10% whole oilseed by dry weight, aligning with Spero’s focus on plant-based dairy alternatives. This research and development centers on innovative plant-based curd production and formulation.

overview_description.description: Spero Foods is a startup disrupting dairy with novel process engineering and food science technology, working to innovate the first mainstream plant-based dairy, because every human deserves healthy food. Spero has been named Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies,  NEXTY’s Best Dairy/Meat Alternative, and The Food Network’s Supermarket Awards. Sold nationally in retail and food service, with over 3,500 auth locations like Kroger, Whole Foods, Publix, and Sprouts.
